audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 5 say Kled and Skill in both layers, but the packet chart gives Kayle both, and the prose already argues Kayle: whys[4] ends 'force the lane now', whys[5] says you snowball first item, and mid calls level 6 'the flip'. Row 3's why is also misfiled — it describes Divine Ascent and Divine Judgment, which are level-6 abilities, under the Levels 4-5 label.
audit.why: Level 6 is where Divine Ascent gives ranged autos and Divine Judgment covers the Chaaaaaaaarge all-in; first item is where a dismounted Kled has no Skaarl to close the gap. That is the whole reason the matchup sits at 54.38%.
audit.corrected: phases[4..5].side and win[4..5] set to Kayle as matched pairs, and whys[3]/whys[4]/whys[5] re-sequenced so each row's reasoning describes its own level. Rows 0-2 (Kled) and row 6 (Kled) already agree with the packet and the prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 3 (Levels 4-5) claims Kayle's level-6 spike a stage early, which advertises a power shift two levels before it exists.
audit.why: Divine Ascent's ranged tier and Divine Judgment both arrive at 6. A player reading 'your first breath of the lane' at level 4 will walk up with melee autos into a mounted Kled.
audit.corrected: whys[3] rewritten to what levels 4-5 actually are — W sustain and Q shred online, mounted Kled still winning extended trades. The spike itself moved into the level-6 row where it belongs. Kept row 3 at Skill rather than following the packet to Kayle: mid explicitly says a mounted Kled still wins extended trades there, and I will not invent a shift the text denies.

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies is never described. dontsFull[1] is titled 'Trade his mounted W' and its body is boilerplate about wasting your own ultimate — the two do not match.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags the auto-reset burst tell for this pairing. Violent Tendencies is four accelerated attacks on a 13s cooldown at rank 1, and the wind-up is the readable moment, not the cast. Kled's burst in the first three levels is that W, not the trap.
audit.corrected: Violent Tendencies added to early with its 13s cooldown and the wind-up tell; dontsFull[1].d rewritten to match its own title.

audit.why: 54.38% over 274 games, consistent with the FAV label.
Divine Judgment is Kayle's real R name. False positive.

edits.before: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with AoE waves and Divine Judgment's invulnerability survives his Chaaaaaaaarge remount all-in — your first breath of the lane.
edits.after: Your W sustain (15s) and Q's Armor/MR shred are online, but a mounted Kled still wins every extended trade — concede CS and wait for a dismount or for 6.

edits.before: Ranged DPS plus E missing-health magic shred kites and burns a dismounted Kled with no Skaarl to chase — force the lane now.
edits.after: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged and Divine Judgment (160s) covers his Chaaaaaaaarge all-in — the lane's first breath is yours.

edits.before: Q's Armor/MR shred and slow plus your scaling auto DPS let you snowball first item into a fight a single-target bruiser can't kite.
edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health shred lets you Q-slow and burn a dismounted Kled with no Skaarl left to close the gap — snowball it.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Kled's lane to take and you know it. His mounted Q, Bear Trap on a Rope, hooks and pulls him onto you, and with Skaarl up his bites out-trade your melee-range autos brutally — you have only one Q, a single point of W sustain, and no dash to escape. Do not step into rope range to throw a Q; last-hit at max range, eat a little poke, and never let him land the grab into an all-in. If he dismounts (loses Skaarl), his range and damage crater — that dismounted window is your only safe trade before 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Kled's lane to take and you know it. His mounted Q, Bear Trap on a Rope, hooks and pulls him onto you, and Violent Tendencies (W, 13s at rank 1) gives him four accelerated swings that shred your melee-range autos — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast, so step out on it. You have one Q, a single point of W sustain, and no dash. Last-hit at max range and never let him land the grab into an all-in. If he dismounts, his range and damage crater — that window is your only safe trade before 6.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies is four fast swings on 13s — walk out on the wind-up.

notes: Rows 4-5 flipped to Kayle in matched pairs. I did NOT follow the packet on row 3 (it wants Kayle at Levels 4-5) because the mid block states a mounted Kled still wins extended trades there; Skill is the honest reading and inventing a level-4 power shift is exactly the failure mode the brief warns about.
